steps.domain_action: The initial singularity provides the raw potential for spacetime.
The universe establishes the Cosmological Principle as its identity.
The scale factor increases during the inflationary epoch.
The Cosmic Microwave Background fixes the state of the early universe.
Parallax measurements establish the first rung of the distance ladder.
Cepheid variables extend the distance ladder to nearby galaxies.
Type Ia Supernovae extend the distance ladder to the Hubble flow.
The measurement process branches into local observations and CMB extrapolations.
Local measurements yield a high Hubble constant value.
CMB measurements yield a low Hubble constant value.
The system holds both values in tension, defining the crisis in cosmology.
Theoretical physicists re-examine early universe physics to find a bridge.
A new physical constant or systematic correction reunites the branches.
The revised Lambda-CDM model recognizes itself in the new data.
The resolved Hubble constant is recorded in the astrophysical tables.
The closed cosmological model contains all observed phenomena.
